message: The project references the following version(s) of Metalama.Framework: {0}. The project must reference a single version of Metalama.Framework, and this version must not be higher than '{1}', the version of the Metalama engine that compiles the project.
title: The project references an unsupported version of Metalama.Framework.
rationale: AspectPipeline.TryInitialize reports the diagnostic in two cases: several versions of Metalama.Framework are referenced, or the referenced version is higher than the engine version ({1} is EngineAssemblyMetadataReader.AssemblyVersion, not a compiler version). The current message mentions only the second case and calls the engine 'the current compiler'. The title is ungrammatical ('has referenced to') and lacks the final period.
